defective_pattern: Unconditionally adding doc.add_heading(title, level=1) when markdown source already contains # Level 1 heading
why_defective: Causes duplicate titles in the generated DOCX, violating document formatting standards and creating visual redundancy.
observed_symptoms: Duplicate title lines in Word document
corrective_remedy: Check for existing level 1 headings in the parsed markdown source before conditionally adding doc.add_heading, or strip the markdown heading if adding manually.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Detecting both doc.add_heading(level=1) and a markdown # heading in the same document generation flow without conditional checks.
